```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = "\\s*,\\s*")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    audienceScore = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    tomatoMeter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
